audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Lucian Levels 1, 3, 6 and 2+ items at 8/10, while the prose on the same page says the opposite at every one of those stages — whys[0] 'both of you are even at Level 1', whys[2] 'your trades stop being free', whys[4] 'his hardest kill window', late 'I lose this outright'. The page also called it an 'Even matchup' at 5.5/10 against a 26.67% win rate.
audit.why: Wukong's Warrior Trickster clone is online at 3 and eats an empowered Lightslinger shot; from Levels 4-5 Nimbus Strike closes the gap Lucian kites with and Crushing Blow's armour shred makes every extended trade worse. Lucian's only clean stage is Level 2.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Lucian / Skill / Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / Wukong in both layers with matching ratings; difficulty raised to 8/10 and carry threat to 8/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why still describe The Culling and Lucian's first item as spikes that win those stages.
audit.why: At 6 Cyclone's knock-up interrupts the Culling channel outright, and at one item Wukong's armour blunts a physical-only kit — neither stage belongs to Lucian.
audit.corrected: Both lines rewritten to the real power shift.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells you that Crushing Blow (Q) is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: It means the tell for his burst is the attack wind-up, not the ability cast — if you wait to see the cast you have already eaten the armour shred. The clone interaction was already covered; this was not.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and spikes[1].text now state the reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in the first person — 'My only real window', 'This flips against me', 'I lose this outright'.
audit.why: Every other matchup page addresses the reader in the second person; a first-person voice reads as the writer's diary rather than coaching and breaks the page's register.
audit.corrected: All three fields rewritten in second person at the same length.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Neither of you can commit at 1 — Q through the wave on his last-hits and take the free chip, nothing more.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster is up now and the clone eats an empowered shot — check which one is real before you spend it.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Nimbus Strike — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Leveled Nimbus Strike dashes through the gap you kite in and Crushing Blow shreds armour — stop taking long trades.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Cyclone knocks you up mid-Culling and the clone finishes you — never channel while his R is up.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first item and armour blunt your physical poke — your spike no longer outruns his, so take the safe farm.

edits.before: Wukong spends Nimbus Strike early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to leave, not the cast.

edits.before: Once his E (Nimbus Strike) is leveled he dashes onto you and Q-shreds your armor faster than you can kite out.
edits.after: Once Nimbus Strike is leveled he dashes onto you and Crushing Blow — an attack reset — shreds your armour on landing.

edits.before: My only real window is Level 2 — Q plus the Lightslinger double-tap can chunk him before his E dash and W clone exist, so cash that in hard. After that it gets ugly fast: do not Q into the clone (the decoy eats your empowered shot and your W mark), and never burn E chasing because his Nimbus Strike out-dashes my disengage. Last-hit at max Q range, mark him with W only when you can follow up, and respect that he survives the burst I'd kill a normal melee with.
edits.after: Your only real window is Level 2 — Q plus the Lightslinger double-tap chunks him before Nimbus Strike and Warrior Trickster exist, so cash it in hard. After that it gets ugly fast: do not Q into the clone (the decoy eats your empowered shot and your W mark), and never burn E chasing, because his dash out-ranges your disengage. Last-hit at max Q range, W-mark him only when you can follow up, and accept that he survives the burst that kills a normal melee.

edits.before: This flips against me. Once his E is leveled he dashes the gap I rely on to kite, and his Q armor-shred means every trade tilts further his way the longer it goes. At 6 his R is the killer — if he Cyclones me mid-Culling the channel is wasted and the clone bursts what's left of my low base HP. Hold E as a panic button for his all-in, not for offense, and don't commit The Culling unless his R is down.
edits.after: This flips against you. Once Nimbus Strike is leveled he dashes the gap you rely on to kite, and Crushing Blow's armour shred means every trade tilts further his way the longer it runs. At 6 Cyclone is the killer — it knocks you up mid-Culling, the channel is wasted, and the clone bursts what is left of your HP. Hold E as a panic button for his all-in, never for offence, and don't commit The Culling while his R is up.

edits.before: I lose this outright. He stacks armor and a Black Cleaver while I'm a physical-only ADC with no percent-HP or true damage to cut through it, so my poke does nothing and his clone plus R delete me in any skirmish. There's no scaling save here — my whole case had to be made at Level 2. Side-lane safe, take what little CS I can under tower, and let my team answer him.
edits.after: You lose this outright. He stacks armour and a Black Cleaver while you are a physical-only ADC with no percent-health or true damage to cut it, so your poke does nothing and his clone plus Cyclone delete you in any skirmish. There is no scaling save here — the whole case had to be made at Level 2. Play the side lane safe, farm what you can under tower, and let your team answer him.
